gear.definition_choice: uniform among the 36 definitions (20 weapons, 3 head/armor/garment/shoes, 4 accessories) of the stage tier; no class-specific armor
gear.rng: two draws per drop: rarity then definition; persist loot cursor/state in server reward checkpoint; retry reuses result
gear.full_inventory: reserve fixed pending claim and advance reservation cursor atomically; pay wallet/items only when space permits; retries do not reroll

supreme_analysis.interpretation: common-equivalent throughput bound for one desired definition, not expected time or guaranteed pity; integer fusion and rare drops require distribution simulation later

cards.roll_interval: One independent card chance per existing five-minute gear interval; D-107: 1–2% per roll, expected1.44–2.88 cards per12h; no guarantee per claim
cards.quality_and_grade: Bronze/Silver/Gold is enhancement quality; Normal/Mini/MVP is source monster class, shown separately.
cards.legacy: Snapshots without card_drops earn no retroactive cards; first farm claim settles that old interval then installs the new profile for subsequent accrual.
